entries.en: to hold or steady with the hand; to prop up
to press or hold down with the hand
to hold something in place so that it does not fall

entries.zh: 忧愁憔悴；使困苦（因劳苦、悲伤、痛苦而憔悴）
entries.en: to afflict; to wear one out with toil, sorrow and pain
to be distressed at heart; to grieve

entries.zh: 极度折磨、痛苦难当（凌迟般苦毒）
entries.en: to torment cruelly; to suffer intensely
entries.notes: 「凌剔」字形特殊（或为「凌迟」一类写法），释义以 L 栏 afligirse mucho 与「凌」字义定为准。

entries.en: affliction; suffering; bitterness
suffering and affliction; hardship

entries.zh: 苦苦（极为痛苦、苦上加苦）
entries.en: to suffer bitterly; great affliction
miserable; to be distressed by hardships
to weep in grief; bitter tears
to cry and wail in affliction
bitter grief and indignation; to grieve and take offense
to flee calamity; to take refuge from hardship

entries.zh: 气煞人（气得人吐血将死）
entries.en: to anger someone until the blood comes out of him; to vex someone to death
entries.notes: L 栏首词带存疑标注 "pasado (?)"，释义以汉字「气殺人」与后半句 afligir a vno hasta… la sangre 为准。

entries.en: to anger someone to death; utterly infuriating

entries.zh: 郁郁将死、苦闷得只剩一死
entries.en: so afflicted that only death is left for him; at death's door from grief
entries.notes: 「局々死」叠字写法少见（M 音 quiòt-quiòt），据 L 栏 solo le falta morir 与音写推断为苦闷至死。

entries.en: to loosen; to let go, release

entries.zh: 松开所绑之物、把绑着的东西放开
entries.en: to untie or loosen what is bound
